reviews.review_text:
Petter H
10 contributions

Verdt et besøk eller flere
Sep 2025 • Solo
I’ve been traveling in Hanoi for 10 days, and this is the only place I’ve returned to several times—and will definitely visit again. The food is excellent, with high standards both in quality and artistic presentation. The menu is varied and rich in options.

The service is outstanding and very friendly. The staff are polite and professional, yet happy to chat if you’d like. They also answer questions about the menu or preparation in a knowledgeable and professional way.

This is also one of the few places I’ve visited that offers high-quality wine and drinks. The bartender can make exactly what you want. I’m not usually a cocktail person, but here I ended up having several, as they matched my taste perfectly. On top of that, the pepole were very pleasant to talk to (a big plus when traveling alone.)
